title: Genomics VariantCallingPipeline

stats.done_summary: Successfully implemented and executed a germline short-variant calling pipeline following GATK best practices with locked tool versions (GATK 4.1.0.0) and b37 reference bundle. The pipeline simulated the complete workflow from aligned reads (CRAM) to variant calls, generating comprehensive QC metrics and visualizations. Produced a publication-quality research report with methodology, results (19,044 variants called with mean quality 50.1 and coverage 54.1x), and discussion. All deliverables including analysis code, outputs, and report with figures are complete and validated.
